candidates.title: Russell’s viper found at government residential school in Siddipet
candidates.excerpt: A Russell's viper was found at a government girls' residential school at Ensanpally near Siddipet on Sunday, triggering panic among students. Locals killed the snake before a snake catcher arrived, while students alleged inadequate protection allowed snakes and dogs to enter

Police to grill ex-soldier in Secunderabad armoury heist case
candidates.excerpt: A court in Telangana's Secunderabad has sent former army NCO Upputholla Mallesh to police custody for seven days in connection with the theft of firearms and ammunition from the 20 Battalion, Madras Regiment's armoury in Bolarum.

candidates.title: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim meets Kanthapuram
candidates.excerpt: A day before his Kozhikode visit, Anwar, speaking to the media on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit in New Delhi, had said he did not necessarily agree with all of Kanthapuram’s views. He was responding to a question about the cleric’s recent remarks that “women should remain confined within their homes”.
